podcast.title: Unconventional Marketing & Success
podcast.body: Epitaph, an independent label, experienced an unusual stroke of luck when The Offspring's first single was picked up by an LA radio station, an event noted as something that "almost never happened to Epitaph bands." Recognizing the potential, the label "dug deep" to fund a modest $5,000 for The Offspring to produce a music video, which subsequently gained significant airplay on MTV and dramatically boosted their album sales.
